sanitized_runtime.observer: Read nearby target position/base Fatigue to recognize this staged actor, observe a debit then current>=155, and print once. No actor/resource/action writes.

observer_source:
local nearby = require('openmw.nearby')
local Actor = require('openmw.types').Actor
local sawDebit = false
local announced = false
return { engineHandlers = { onFrame = function()
    if announced then return end
    for _, actor in ipairs(nearby.actors) do
        local position = actor.position
        if math.abs(position.x - 672) < 4 and math.abs(position.y - 60) < 4 then
            local fatigue = Actor.stats.dynamic.fatigue(actor)
            if fatigue.base == 155 and fatigue.current < 155 then sawDebit = true end
            if sawDebit and fatigue.current >= 155 then
                print('M15 NPC break fatigue recovered: current=' .. tostring(fatigue.current))
                announced = true
            end
        end
    end
end } }
